title: Djinni Scimitar
summary: A +1 scimitar dealing 1d6 + 1 Slashing plus 2d10 Poison. Normally inaccessible to player characters.

fields.Availability: Wielded by Djinn. The item documents a controller workaround, rather than ordinary acquisition.
fields.Base value: 30 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and pinned item and dependency revisions.
